# Pull request / 改动说明

## Problem and result / 问题与结果

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. / 说明问题和改动后的行为。

## Evidence / 验证依据

List checks run and remaining limits; distinguish targets from results.
列出已运行的检查和剩余限制，区分性能目标与实测结果。

## Review / 自审

- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese agree, including revisions and terms. / 双语含义、修订号和术语一致。
- [ ] API facts, ownership, failure cases and measurement boundaries are preserved. / 保留 API 事实、所有权、异常和测量边界。
- [ ] Local checks pass; warnings and prose have been reviewed. / 本地检查通过，提示和文字已自审。
- [ ] No private paths, credentials, logs or unapproved media. / 无私人路径、凭据、日志或未经批准的图片。
- [ ] Scope matches the current phase; dependencies/risks are explained. / 符合当前阶段，已说明依赖和风险。
